limitations: Single-file artifact was verified through localhost with asset network requests disabled. This environment blocks file:// browser navigation; direct file opening was not claimed as verified.
Automated phone input and software WebGL are not physical-device measurements.
The chat has no file-export or public-preview tool. Workspace paths are not advertised as downloadable web links.
Commits and backup archives remain local until copied outside the environment or explicitly pushed to GitHub.
